Vendored third-party libraries in this folder — bundled locally so
GoOnlinePOS works with zero internet access. Unmodified from their
published npm packages.

xlsx.full.min.js
  Package : xlsx (SheetJS)
  Version : 0.18.5
  License : Apache-2.0
  Source  : https://www.npmjs.com/package/xlsx

zxing-browser.min.js
  Package : @zxing/browser
  Version : 0.2.1
  License : MIT
  Source  : https://www.npmjs.com/package/@zxing/browser
